review.note: Date, act and President (Theodore Roosevelt) are right, but in 1908 the unit was a national forest, the Minnesota National Forest, not a "forest reserve." Its predecessor reservation came from the act of June 27, 1902 (32 Stat. 400). Davis gives a proclamation citation (34 Stat. 3259) for this event; the Statutes show it was an act of Congress.
